source_caption:
Prison Break follows Michael Scofield, a brilliant engineer who deliberately gets himself imprisoned so he can help his wrongly accused brother, Lincoln Burrows, escape from death row. Using detailed plans hidden within his tattoos, Michael carefully navigates prison life while facing dangerous inmates, corrupt officials, and constant risks.

In Prison Break, the story expands beyond the prison as conspiracies, government secrets, and betrayals begin to unfold. The series is known for its suspenseful pacing, clever escape strategies, and emotional brotherhood between Michael and Lincoln. Its intense cliffhangers and action-filled storytelling made it one of the most popular thriller dramas of its era.
